section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1975
title: 25 Volume of Suicides in States, Union Territories and Cities The volume of suicides per lakh of population for India as a whole was 7.17, for States as a whole 7.15 and for the Union Territories as a whole it was 8.29. The volume of suicides for Union Territories was higher than the States and the all-India average. Among States, the volume of Suicides per lakh of population ranged between 23.07 to 0.04. The maximum volume of suicides per lakh of population was for Tripura (23.07) and the minimum was for Jammu & Kashmir (0.04). The volume of suicides for Union Territories as whole per lakh of population was 8.29. The maximum was for Pondicherry (58.0) and the minimum was for Mizoram (0.53).
